title: A Extraction for the Drop
author: Juniper Eastwick
blurb: Kestrel Nakamura, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
